purpose: Training/validation-only feasibility pilot, not a final experiment and not a proposed novel model
encoder: ResNet18 with locally cached ImageNet-1K weights; fully frozen, evaluation mode
normalisation: RGB /255, then ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] and std [0.229,0.224,0.225]. Normalised depth repeated over 3 channels uses the same fixed transform for this pilot only.
episode_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of non-padding evaluation-slot feature vectors; each distinct RGB representative used at most once
head: Single linear layer; L2-normalise each modality's episode vector before fitting
loss: Cross entropy with inverse training-episode class frequency, normalised to mean weight one
acquisition_standardisation: Mean and standard deviation fitted on training episodes only
selection: Fixed steps, no validation checkpoint selection or hyperparameter search
test_use: None: held-out test episodes are excluded before reading image/depth cache rows or extracting features
reporting: Validation metrics of all variants and all seeds; not evidence of novel-model effectiveness or cross-farm performance
